title: Make test not requiring -test suffix
body: This is artificial and not necessary since we are already putting all the tests in a `__tests__` subfolder. The advantage is that then we can have direct relation between test files and files being tested.

comments.body:
> This is artificial and not necessary since we are already putting all the tests in a **tests**

I think the use case is when you have fixtures that are not tests but still .js files then it's easier to have -test.js only for test files.
We don't have any ;) But I get the point ;)
